titulo_es: In the accommodation: Vocabulary and forms
intro: It includes data on a reservation and basic accommodation standards. Read the French first; open the translation when you want to check your understanding.

texto: It includes data on a reservation and basic accommodation standards. Find first names, days, places and figures: in notices and chips they are usually easy to locate.
Attention point: The dates indicate entry and exit; « compris » specifies which services are included. In this fragment, «compris» means «including».

frases.fr: Le petit déjeuner est compris et servi de sept à dix heures.
frases.es: El desayuno está incluido y se sirve de siete a diez.
frases.en: Breakfast is included and is served from seven to ten.

frases.es: La recepción está en la planta baja, cerca de la entrada.
frases.en: The reception is on the ground floor, near the entrance.
